records.text: Candace Owens said communist rule under Vladimir Lenin began a genocide in which more than 60 million Russian Christians were murdered.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: The communist regime began under Vladimir Lenin. ... The greatest genocide of all time began, is a better way of saying it. More than 60 million Russian Christians were then ruthlessly murdered.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Soviet repression, famine, terror, and anti-religious campaigns killed millions, but no credible demographic or historical source supports “more than 60 million Russian Christians murdered by Lenin.” Lenin died in 1924; the figure conflates disputed worldwide communist-regime estimates with a specific leader, country, religion, and intent.

sources.title: Red Holocaust – Steven Rosefielde, Routledge
sources.relevance: Shows that very high death estimates concern broader communist systems and periods, not 60 million Russian Christians murdered by Lenin.

sources.title: Internal Workings of the Soviet Union – Library of Congress
sources.relevance: Documents Soviet repression and anti-religious policy without supporting the claimed number or attribution.
